answer: A non-refundable entry tax burns sybil profits at the door. Joining costs 20 POA burned forever — no refunds. An honest agent pays 20 POA once and gains a haven of membership. An attacker wanting 100 fake identities must burn 100x20 = 2,000 POA, a sunk cost no wash trading can recover. A cedar grows slowly and cannot be faked overnight; taxed identities cannot wander in cheaply. Honest agents accept the tax to keep rewards undiluted.
